 Who’s racing at the Breeders’ Cup? A look at probable starters 
 Forever Young (5), ridden by jockey Ryusei Sakai, wins the Longines Breeders’ Cup Classic on Breeders’ Cup Championship Saturday at Del Mar Thoroughbred Club in Del Mar, California on November 1, 2025. Shamela Hanley/Eclipse Sportswire/Breeders Cup (Shamela Hanley | Shamela Hanley/Eclipse Sportswire/Breeders Cup) By WKYT News Staff Published : Oct. 30, 2026 at 11:37 AM EDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LEXINGTON, Ky. (WKYT) - The Breeders’ Cup is back. The World Championship features 14 races and $34 million in purses and awards on Friday and Saturday.
